character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A mall mannequin horror enemy for a 1990s American shopping mall horror roguelite. A humanoid figure that is clearly a shop mannequin: smooth glossy pale beige plastic with visible mould seam lines, and NO facial features at all - a blank featureless face, no eyes, no mouth, no hair. Dressed in the remains of a 1990s clothing-store outfit: a mustard ribbed sweater and dark trousers. Corruption: the plastic is cracked across one shoulder and the hip with dark organic tissue showing through the cracks, the neck stretched and twisted unnaturally, one arm hanging at a wrong angle with plastic fingers splayed, and crazing spreading down the chest. Pose is standing, stiff, upright, arms hanging slightly away from the body. CRITICAL: it must still read at a glance as a shop mannequin - smooth beige plastic, blank face and mould seams stay clearly recognisable. STYLE: detailed late-SNES pixel art, crisp hard pixels, clean deliberate clusters, selective outlines, minimal dithering, no anti-aliasing, no blur. LIGHTING: neutral overhead fluorescent mall lighting. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos anywhere.
